issues.description: Ordinary YouTube audio fails remotely because HPX requests upstream progressive ranges larger than YouTube currently accepts.

reproduction.command: authenticated curl range matrix against production /api/v1/stream?proxy=true

acceptance_test.criterion: A real ordinary YouTube stream serves open-ended and sequential ranges without HTTP 502 and remains available beyond the former cutoff.

root_cause.explanation: The progressive proxy forced 8 MiB upstream ranges, while production YouTube responses now reject ranges above a source-dependent ceiling with 403; HPX translated that into 502 for the phone.

issues.description: HPX remote streaming lacks the patched POT provider and ordered web-embedded/legacy fallback already approved for YouTube playback.

reproduction.command: authenticated 64 KiB production range probes against saved ordinary streams

acceptance_test.criterion: HPX resolves ordinary YouTube streams through pinned POT, web-embedded, then legacy strategies and serves playable remote bytes.

root_cause.explanation: The HPX resolver never received the pinned POT provider or web-embedded fallback and accepted nonempty yt-dlp output without proving the media URL was usable, so exit-zero 403 candidates were cached as successes.
